partial_sample: completed UTM exports, not random national sample
model: high * bs(log1p(corrected distance), df=5) + scaled lon + lat + elevation + slope + MAT + log1p(MAP) + lon^2 + lat^2 + lon*lat + C(year) + C(2018 modal landcover)
standardization: common empirical covariate distribution in complete-case low/high subset
CI: pointwise normal delta method, clustered sandwich; conditional on empirical standardization distribution
limitations: centroid distances, not within-cell vegetation distances
no grid realignment or resolution reaggregation
spatial block sizes are sensitivity choices, not estimated correlation lengths
multiple exploratory contrasts, no multiplicity correction
